CS 234: Data Types and Structures
Description: Top-down design of data structures. Using representation-independent data types. Introduction to commonly used data types, including lists, sets, mappings, and trees. Selection of data representation.
Requirements: Prereq: One of CS 116, 136, 138, 146 or (CS 114 with at least 60%; CS 115 or CS 135). Not open to Honours Computer Science, Data Science (BCS, BMath), BCFM, BSE students. Antireq: BME 122, CS 240/240E, ECE 250, MSE 240, MTE 140, SYDE 223
